_meta.engagement: Synthetic Survey Panel: Concept Test with Creative Directors
_meta.notes: Meta-test: head-to-head comparison of a synthetic AI survey panel vs. a traditional human survey panel. Panel of 100 marketing and agency creative directors choosing which they would purchase for a single concept test.

concepts.name: AI Synthetic Survey Panel
concepts.description: You need to run a consumer concept test for a product or ad campaign your team is developing. This service uses AI to generate a synthetic survey panel of 100 demographically diverse respondents who evaluate your concept. Each synthetic respondent provides a purchase intent rating on a 1-5 scale and detailed written reasoning explaining what they like, what concerns them, and whether they'd buy. The methodology is based on peer-reviewed research showing that AI-generated survey responses reproduce real human purchase intent distributions with approximately 90% accuracy. Results are delivered within 4 hours as a polished report with demographic breakdowns, segment analysis, and actionable recommendations. Cost: $500 for one concept test with 100 respondents.

concepts.name: Traditional Human Survey Panel
concepts.description: You need to run a consumer concept test for a product or ad campaign your team is developing. This service recruits 100 real human respondents matched to your target demographic through a traditional online survey panel. Each respondent rates their purchase intent on a 1-5 scale and provides written feedback explaining their reasoning. Respondents are screened, verified, and quality-checked to ensure genuine responses. Results are delivered in 2-3 weeks as a polished report with demographic breakdowns, segment analysis, and actionable recommendations. Cost: $15,000 for one concept test with 100 respondents.

survey_question.text: How likely would you be to purchase this survey service for your next concept test?
